nora: New proposal for tightening postmortem closures — goal: no stale remediation cards older than 30d without a clear next step. Short pilot idea below. Feedback?

nora: Closure gates & minimal workflow (pilot):
T+0: incident declared, IC named, Impact tags added (latency/errors/data-loss)
T+48h: triage summary posted + list of candidate remediations
T+7d: remediation card(s) created with required fields: owner, ETA, verification test, priority, recurrence_flag
T+14d: verification check — owner must post a 1-line verification status in-thread or escalate
T+21d: closure gate review — if verification present -> close; if not -> escalate to escrow owner or mark long-term with sponsor
T+30d: auto-alert for any open card not meeting gate with explicit next-step requirement

nora: Key differences from current practice: a) explicit verification step at T+14, b) an escrow takeover path at T+21 for short/medium work, c) long-term (>45d) actions require a sponsor and quarterly checkpoints.

rachael: love the verification gate. Suggest adding an SLO impact field (P0/P1/P2) on the card so we can prioritize escrow takeovers.

priya: ops-bot can enforce the gates. I can add automation: create cards at T+7 for P1/P0, set reminder at T+14 for verification, and at T+21 auto-assign to escrow if no update. ops-bot will tag the thread with card links.

ops-bot: automation_registered -> "create_remediation_card_T+7" for thread 2468101214.

alexc: IC rotation tweak: keep 2-week IC windows but rotate the escrow responsibility weekly within that window (primary IC retains custody). This spreads knowledge without too many handoffs.

tony: for recurrence detection, propose a lightweight heatmap: service x symptom counts over 90d. If a cell >3, mark related threads with "pattern-review" and schedule a 30m sync. Keeps us from repeating fixes.

nora: good. keep pattern reviews short and require one actionable mitigation that can land in 7 days. invite product/CS if customers affected.

priya: wiring note: ops-bot will post the heatmap link weekly and will auto-tag threads on threshold. I can scope the tracker changes today.

ops-bot: reminder_scheduled -> "T+14 verification_check" for thread 2468101214.

rachael: operational ask: owners should drop a one-line "accept ownership" reply so ops-bot can pin them to the card. Also recommend owners include one small smoke test as verification.

alexc: ack. I'll add the SLO impact field and the one-line acceptance flow to the runbook.

tony: ack. I'll prototype the heatmap query and share in #eng-sre by EOD.

nora: ack. I'll run the pilot on next P1 and collect metrics: time-to-close, percent auto-takeovers, recurrence signals.

priya: ack. I'll enable ops-bot automation for the pilot and post the tracker card link once created.

ops-bot: reminder_closed -> "T+7 create_remediation_card" for thread 2468101214.

nora: thanks everyone. If the pilot looks good we'll roll the gates into the incident playbook and add the heatmap to the monthly oncall retro agenda.
